documents.name: Bochnia Salt Mine
documents.summary: A four-hour underground historical journey combining authentic salt workings, a mining train, multimedia interpretation and an underground boat crossing.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Transport, authentic workings and theatrical interpretation combine into one of Europe’s most experiential industrial-heritage visits.

visualSignals.label: Experience
visualSignals.value: underground industrial heritage · guided mine journey

booking.note: Select the boat/multimedia route and desired language support in advance.

coreExperience.note: Interpretation matters; multilingual audio keeps the route usable without Polish.

guidedTours.note: Foreign-language guide availability should be checked in advance.

stairs.label: Long route includes about 700 stairs
stairs.note: Check health and mobility suitability before booking.

temperature.label: Dress for 15–17 °C underground
temperature.note: Bring a warm layer and sturdy footwear.

coverImage.alt: Illuminated underground chamber inside the historic Bochnia Salt Mine

documents.name: Copernicus Science Centre

documents.whyWorthwhile: A flagship hands-on science centre with enough experimentation density to reward a long family visit.

documents.name: Guido Mine and Queen Louise Adit
documents.localName: Kopalnia Guido i Sztolnia Królowa Luiza
documents.summary: A multi-site underground industrial destination combining a 320 m mine descent, machinery, mine transport and the Queen Louise underground boat route.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Few industrial sites offer this much movement, machinery, darkness and authentic underground space in one regional destination.

visualSignals.label: Experience
visualSignals.value: underground industrial heritage · multi-site mine journey

booking.note: Book the exact route, time and language; combining both sites requires sequencing.

coreExperience.note: Guided interpretation is integral; choose a supported-language departure.

guidedTours.note: English and Czech are available on selected routes/departures rather than universally.

language-route.label: Book the correct language departure
language-route.note: Do not assume every departure has English or Czech interpretation.

two-sites.label: This is a two-site destination
two-sites.note: Guido Mine and Queen Louise Adit use separate entrances and routes in Zabrze.
